title: A Process Conception of Psychotherapy
coreMove: Follow the living movement of the encounter without abandoning discipline or hiding inside technique.
sourcePressure: Therapy is framed as disciplined unfolding process rather than an external technique applied to a passive object. Frozen sidecar ch07 supports the heading, part placement, and broad thematic claims; it exposes no chapter-local named anecdotes, studies, or places.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Using process as an excuse for vagueness or rejecting technique altogether.
sourceAnchorNote: The frozen source exposes no usable chapter-local named person, study, institution, place, date, or anecdotal artifact from Rogers here. Use fictional protagonists only; do not invent named Rogers cases or studies.

hook: opening with a definition of process conception
counterintuition: Most people think X, but Y
It is not about being nice
The paradox is that acceptance changes everything
